† [יָשַׁט] vb. only
Hiph. Impf. extend, hold out (late) (NH Hiph. id.; Aramaic Aph. אוֹשֵׁיט, ܐܰܘܫܶܛ id.;? Assyrian ašṭu, extended, mighty LyonSargontexte 60 DlHWB144; Arabic وَسَطَ is penetrate into the middle of)—יוֹשִׁיט שַׁרְבִיט הַזָּהָב לְ Est 4:11 hold out the golden sceptre to, so (וַיּ֫וֹשֶׁט) 5:2; 8:4.
